The '''Tkashi Ruins''' are ancient [[troll]] ruins found in [[Stranglethorn Vale]], south-west of [[Nesingwary's Expedition]]. A large group of [[Bloodscalp tribe|Bloodscalp]] trolls live here.

==Notes==
[[Green Hills of Stranglethorn - Page 21|Page 21]] of [[Hemet Nesingwary|Hemet Nesingwary's]] autobiography Green Hills of Stranglethorn mentioned that the famed hunter and his followers passed through the ruins without incident.
